name: SubDL Scribe
description: SubDL Scribe brings SubDL.com to Jellyfin: it downloads missing subtitles for the languages and libraries you pick and uploads your own. Download is on by default; upload is off — enable at your choice. Requires a SubDL login and API Key plus a TMDb API Key.
overview: Sync subtitles with SubDL — download missing and upload new subtitles.

versions.changelog:
v12.1.12.161: A subtitle is its own datum, and the download mark is gone.
    A subtitle carries its own properties - language, hearing-impaired, forced -
    and its own hash, whether it sits in the container or as a file beside it.
    Treating the variant as a spelling of the language is what re-fetched
    subtitles that were already on disk.
    The download mark is removed. It was a second answer beside the rows that
    describe the subtitles, and the two drifted: the check that trusted it asked
    the disk plus the stored variant verdict while the check that wrote it asked
    the disk alone, so a variant inside the container kept the mark from ever
    being written and the regular subtitle was fetched again on every pass (41
    downloads in one run against a 50/day limit, the same content hash three days
    running). Completeness is now derived on every ask by one reader the
    pipeline, the seeder and the refresh share, and the two search pools are fed
    separately - only a missing variant asks for the hearing-impaired side.
    Forced joins as a second property of the datum. SubDL has no forced
    counterpart, so a forced subtitle is observed and never sought, fetched or
    uploaded, and it never counts as coverage - one rule, not five call sites.
    The stored shape changed: the data file reports schema version 2 and older
    records are ignored rather than rewritten.
    Every datum states hearing-impaired and forced explicitly as ja or nein;
    null means the row does not say, and a gap is read as no claim rather than as
    a no - so the item is worked once more and that pass states the value. Rows
    written before the field existed get it backfilled from their own file name,
    a plain row included.
